parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. This value is generated by the client and must be unique for each request. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the source cluster.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) that contains the endpoint.
